name: This Is Where I'd Put My Trophy If I Had One
visual_description: Two-panel cartoon of Timmy's Dad from The Fairly OddParents gesturing enthusiastically to an empty pedestal, then clenching his hands furiously.
usage_context: Used to express frustration, irony, or self-deprecation about lacking something one should or wants to have.

example.top_text: THIS IS WHERE I'D PUT MY SAVINGS

text_areas.description: Setup phrase stating what would be displayed
Punchline lamenting the absence of the item
